chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥakīm, from Muʿammar ibn Khallād, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in praying toward the قبر so long as the قبر is not taken as a qiblah.

key_terms.قِبْلَةً: a qiblah, a direction of ritual orientation in prayer
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat facing a grave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat in relation to graves. It permits praying in the direction of a grave, provided that the grave is not treated as a qiblah.
